major_events: Su Ming awakens Xu Hui on a floating island of the Ninth Tribe, and their interaction transitions from silent relief over survival to lighthearted bickering about her scars (第四卷 崛起神源 第941章 谁起的执念……).
Su Ming and Xu Hui spend multiple years traveling through the Shenyuan Star Ocean, evading two-headed scorpion-like star beasts during their escape (第四卷 崛起神源 第948章 横天族).
Su Ming explores the cursed star in the Shenyuan Star Ocean, unravelling the underlying curse dynamics of the Hengtian clan (第四卷 崛起神源 第950章 诅咒星辰).

Su Ming encounters a middle-aged fate master who severs his connection with the magic treasure Dao Kui Mountain, prompting Su Ming to counter with Wushan's Zhan Sansha technique which he now recognizes as a Mastering Fate method (第四卷 崛起神源 第956章 斩缘！).
Su Ming learns about the rare Fifth Stones and starts tracking down the location of the Fifth Furnace (第四卷 崛起神源 第968章 第五烘炉).
Su Ming ambushes the fleeing Huokui Patriarch while he is pursued by the Tree Ancestor in the Fifth Furnace, successfully capturing the Tree Ancestor's core sapling (第四卷 崛起神源 第991章 小小树苗).
Su Ming discovers a skeleton holding the Wangsheng Spear in the deep chambers of the Fifth Furnace, confirming that it does not belong to Lieshan Xiu (第四卷 崛起神源 第1005章 往事枪).
Su Ming meets the fat cultivator Zhu Youcai inside the Fifth Furnace, learning of his tragic past and his participation in the furnace's chessboard trial (第四卷 崛起神源 第1004章 朱有财).
Su Ming fuses with the E'cang avatar to slay competitors for the furnace slots, noting that the white-haired Su Xuanyi is allowed to claim a slot without opposition (第四卷 崛起神源 第1013章 苏、轩、衣！).
Su Ming's three avatars execute the Three Mountains Reflecting the Moon technique to force open his main body's eye across realms, only to be blocked by Di Tian (第四卷 崛起神源 第1022章 三山映月！).
Su Ming realizes his 100-year life in Suxing was an illusion projected by the Jue Mask, and shatters the mask to break free back to the Fifth Sea (第四卷 崛起神源 第1035章 绝之面具！).
Su Ming declares his intention to return home, entering the West Ring Rift after the illusion collapses (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1036章 我要，回家).
Su Ming visits the Yinsheng desert planet, defeats the candle-light entity that once determined his exile, and integrates the physical body of Kong Mo (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1051章 孔摩肉身).
Su Ming arrives at the Dao Chen Sect under the identity of Highness Dao Kong (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1062章 没有灭，哪来生).
Su Ming faces a massive platform challenge by seven million sect disciples and establishes dominance by ruthlessly executing all challengers, starting with邯某 (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1072章 大家好，我叫德顺).
Su Ming enters the Fourth Realm of Fame and makes the guardian disappear, causing widespread shock among the sect elders and princes (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1082章 他的名字，叫做桑).
Su Ming enters the Dao Ocean trial and clashes with the Black-Robed figures, discovering the plot to replace the Three Barrens (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1092章 我是道海之先).
Su Xuanyi triggers a massive sacrificial array that destroys the Dao Chen Sect; the survivor Deshun rescues the poisoned and regressed Xu Hui (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1142章 道晨宗劫！).
Su Ming uses the Mortality Refining Technique to enter mortal reincarnations, living his first life as a blind fisherman who meets Xu Hui's soul-projection (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1149章 老爷爷，这条鱼给我好么).

Su Ming reunites with his Ninth Summit brothers in the Dao Chen Realm but quickly sets off with them to investigate the east when his avatar loses connection near the Tianxiang Array (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1173章 天香阵).
character_state_transitions: Su Ming transitions from a standard cultivator to a Fate Master by realizing his childhood technique Zhan Sansha is a form of Mastering Fate (第四卷 崛起神源 第956章 斩缘！).
Su Ming transitions from a trapped dreamer to an enlightened escapee by identifying inconsistencies in Suxing's simulation and shattering the Jue Mask (第四卷 崛起神源 第1035章 绝之面具！).
Su Ming integrates Kong Mo's physical body to transition into his new identity as Highness Dao Kong within the Dao Chen Sect (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1051章 孔摩肉身).
Su Ming transitions from a doubted candidate to a feared executioner in the Dao Chen Sect by ruthlessly killing anyone who steps onto his challenge platform (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1072章 大家好，我叫德顺).
Su Ming transitions his consciousness into a blind mortal fisherman using the Mortality Refining Technique to heal his fractured soul (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1149章 老爷爷，这条鱼给我好么).
Xu Hui transitions from a proud tribal leader to a vulnerable, powerless companion of Su Ming during their journey in the Shenyuan Star Ocean (第四卷 崛起神源 第941章 谁起的执念……).

Xu Hui transitions from an adult companion to a severely poisoned, white-haired child survivor after the Dao Chen Sect disaster, planting a Scorpion Gu in Deshun to secure a guide (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1142章 道晨宗劫！).
Deshun transitions from a carefree, business-minded disciple to a grieving survivor forced to carry and guide the child Xu Hui due to the Scorpion Shadow Gu (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1142章 道晨宗劫！).

Baifeng transitions from a scheming competitor to a dying, reflective woman who spends her final days expressing her memories in the empty ruins before being assisted by Su Ming (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1149章 老爷爷，这条鱼给我好么).
The Ninth Summit brothers transition from isolated survivors scattered across the realm to a unified family after their emotional reunion with Su Ming (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1170章 重逢！).
long_form_mechanisms: Fate Thread Severance: A method of Mastering Fate where a cultivator visualizes the intangible threads connecting target entities and physically severs them to disable control or cut ties (第四卷 崛起神源 第956章 斩缘！).

Zhan Sansha Space-Time Alteration: A Wushan technique that alters the feng shui layout of a location to manipulate fate, changing natural alignments to break seals or bypass boundaries (第四卷 崛起神源 第956章 斩缘！).
Fifth Furnace Arena: A collapsing cosmic chessboard where contestants must eliminate each other to claim the limited slots available to reach the Fifth True World (第四卷 崛起神源 第968章 第五烘炉).

Three Mountains Reflecting the Moon Projection: A spatial projection technique where Su Ming's three avatars align their internal moons and channel the collapse of a dimension to pierce cross-realm seals (第四卷 崛起神源 第1022章 三山映月！).

Jue Mask Simulation: An illusion mechanism that constructs a flawless replica of the wearer's desired home or world, which can only be shattered by focusing on items the wearer has never seen (第四卷 崛起神源 第1035章 绝之面具！).
Lotus Platform Isolation: The electoral system of Dao Chen Sect that utilizes isolating light barriers to create private deathmatches, preventing external interference (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1072章 大家好，我叫德顺).
Mortality Refining Cycle: A recovery technique requiring a protective field of Extreme Dark Light and nine successive mortal lifetimes to mend deep spiritual cracks (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1149章 老爷爷，这条鱼给我好么).
Scorpion Shadow Gu: A curse that morphs the victim's meridians into a scorpion shape, releasing freezing poison that can only be relieved by the planter's designated savior (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1142章 道晨宗劫！).
continuity_observations: Su Ming's realization that the skeleton in the Fifth Furnace cannot be Lieshan Xiu because the true Zhanxie spear is suppressing the Barbarian Imperial Capital, showing consistency with early worldbuilding (第四卷 崛起神源 第1005章 往事枪).
The narrative explicitly traces the developmental arc of Zhan Sansha from Wushan, through Shaman land, to its final form as a Mastering Fate technique in Shenyuan (第四卷 崛起神源 第956章 斩缘！).

The narrative irony where the Yinsheng candle-light entity once decided the fate of Su Ming (under the name Mosu) 1000 years ago, but neither recognizes the other in this second encounter (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1051章 孔摩肉身).
The appearance of the ghost face marking on the Eldest Brother's chest, linking to his past suffering and the overarching curse affecting the Ninth Summit disciples (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1170章 重逢！).
Su Ming's mention of Xu Hui's moles at the start of the chunk connects back to him changing her clothes when she was severely injured and unconscious in the previous chunk (第四卷 崛起神源 第941章 谁起的执念……).
The Bald Crane's sudden retrieval of the Mortality Refining Technique from its fractured memories continues the narrative thread of its forgotten, exalted origin (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1149章 老爷爷，这条鱼给我好么).
The continuous thread of Su Xuanyi's chess game manipulation, from entering the slot in the Fifth Furnace to orchestrating the sacrifice of the Dao Chen Sect (第四卷 崛起神源 第1013章 苏、轩、衣！).
Su Ming's theft of Dao Kong's identity by taking over Kong Mo's body continues the motif of deception and infiltration established in previous arcs (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1051章 孔摩肉身).
style_observations: Philosophical Monologues: Er Gen frames cosmic combat with repetitive, poetic phrases about the nature of life and death, and the ceasing of fate (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1062章 没有灭，哪来生).
Temporal Jump Montages: The use of rhythmic, poetic time jumps to summarize long journeys through the star ocean, focusing on relationship changes rather than daily details (第四卷 崛起神源 第948章 横天族).
Abrupt Comedic Transitions: Balancing grim themes with sudden humor, such as Xu Hui's playful torture of Deshun or the bickering between Su Ming and the Bald Crane (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1142章 道晨宗劫！).
Authorial Commentary: The narrator directly interjects to comment on the circular nature of fate and the inversion of power dynamics over centuries (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1051章 孔摩肉身).
Scale Hyperbole: Frequent use of massive numbers (e.g. 7 million challengers, 30 million zhang) to convey the grand, mythic scale of cosmic combat (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1072章 大家好，我叫德顺).
Quiet Melancholy: Shifting to a somber, emotional tone during moments of reflection, such as the dying Baifeng's monologue or the silent drinking of the Ninth Summit brothers (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1170章 重逢！).

creation_family_evidence.volume_transition_marker: The presence of the parenthetical volume end marker '（本卷终）' right before Volume 5 Chapter 1036, which is a classic web novel publishing format used by Er Gen to partition major story arcs.
creation_family_evidence.chapter_naming_structure: The use of sequential sub-parts for a single chapter topic, such as '震名之地（一）' to '震名之地（七）' (Chapters 1075-1081), '那一眼……（一）' to '那一眼（六）' (Chapters 1097-1102), and '我的右手！（一）' to '我的右手！（七）' (Chapters 1103-1109), which is a signature chapter naming habit of Er Gen.
creation_family_evidence.signature_themes: The core themes of '执念' (obsession) and '宿命' (destiny) which define the novel Pursuit of Truth, alongside Er Gen's classic reincarnation/mortal-experience trope seen in Wushan's legacy and the Mortality Refining Technique.

originality_risks: The Overwhelming Challenger Trope: The standard xianxia cliché where the protagonist faces millions of challengers but defeats them with one-sided ease (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1072章 大家好，我叫德顺).
The Illusion Twist: The revelation that 100 years of life in Suxing was an illusion created by the Jue Mask risks undermining the emotional investment in those events (第四卷 崛起神源 第1035章 绝之面具！).
Amnesiac Pet Convenience: The Bald Crane randomly remembering the exact secret recovery technique right when the protagonist needs it is a convenient plot device (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1149章 老爷爷，这条鱼给我好么).
Cold/Tsundere Romance Dynamic: The bickering, cold-male and annoyed-female dynamic during their escape across the star ocean is a standard trope in Chinese web novels (第四卷 崛起神源 第948章 横天族).

The Sacrificial Sect Tragedy: The sudden destruction of the protagonist's sect (Dao Chen Sect) by a mastermind (Su Xuanyi) to reset the protagonist's status to a rogue, vengeful wanderer (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1142章 道晨宗劫！).
